title: When the Confession Turns
author: Wren Coldharbour
blurb: Dominic Sterling, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
